<script>
// Typing Effect Logic
(function() {
  const phrases = [
    "AI & Data Infra, For Agents",
    "Public Data to Structured Insight",
    "Building the Agentic Data Layer",
    "270 APIs, One MCP Server"
  ];
  let phraseIdx = 0, charIdx = 0, deleting = false;
  const el = document.getElementById("typing-text");
  if (!el) return;

  function tick() {
    const current = phrases[phraseIdx];
    if (!deleting) {
      el.textContent = current.substring(0, charIdx + 1);
      charIdx++;
      if (charIdx === current.length) {
        setTimeout(() => { deleting = true; tick(); }, 2500);
        return;
      }
      setTimeout(tick, 40 + Math.random() * 40);
    } else {
      el.textContent = current.substring(0, charIdx - 1);
      charIdx--;
      if (charIdx === 0) {
        deleting = false;
        phraseIdx = (phraseIdx + 1) % phrases.length;
        setTimeout(tick, 500);
        return;
      }
      setTimeout(tick, 20);
    }
  }
  setTimeout(tick, 1000);
})();

// Canvas Particle Network Logic (Lightweight)
(function initCanvas() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('particle-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let particles = [];
  let mouse = { x: null, y: null, radius: 150 };
  canvas.parentElement.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      mouse.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      mouse.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
  });
  canvas.parentElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
      mouse.x = null;
      mouse.y = null;
  });

  // Space Configuration
  const properties = {
      particleColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', // Star white
      particleRadius: 1.8,
      particleCount: 90,
      particleMaxVelocity: 0.1,
      lineMaxDist: 130,
      lineColor: '100, 116, 139' // Slate Gray for faint connections
  };

  function resize() {
      if (!canvas.parentElement) return;
      canvas.width = canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.parentElement.offsetHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  class Particle {
      constructor() {
          this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
          this.velocityX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * properties.particleMaxVelocity * 2;
          this.velocityY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * properties.particleMaxVelocity * 2;
      }
      update() {
          if (this.x + this.velocityX > canvas.width || this.x + this.velocityX < 0) this.velocityX *= -1;
          if (this.y + this.velocityY > canvas.height || this.y + this.velocityY < 0) this.velocityY *= -1;
          this.x += this.velocityX;
          this.y += this.velocityY;

          // Mouse interaction
          if (mouse.x != null && mouse.y != null) {
              let dx = mouse.x - this.x;
              let dy = mouse.y - this.y;
              let distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
              if (distance < mouse.radius) {
                  this.x += dx * 0.015;
                  this.y += dy * 0.015;
              }
          }
      }
  }

  function drawLines() {
      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
          for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
              const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
              const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
              const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
              if (dist < properties.lineMaxDist) {
                  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${properties.lineColor}, ${1 - dist / properties.lineMaxDist})`;
                  ctx.beginPath();
                  ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                  ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                  ctx.stroke();
              }
          }
      }
  }

  function loop() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(p => {
          p.update();
          ctx.fillStyle = properties.particleColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, properties.particleRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
      });
      drawLines();
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < properties.particleCount; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
  loop();
})();

// Scroll Reveal Observer
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
});

// Bento Card Spotlight Effect
document.querySelectorAll('.bento-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    card.style.setProperty('--mouse-x', `${x}px`);
    card.style.setProperty('--mouse-y', `${y}px`);
  });
});
</script>
